result.topic_en: The page tabulates the coefficients for the order m+n=11, built from binomial coefficients, states the rule for writing them down, and begins §36 by introducing the notation n(ν) for binomial coefficients.
result.transcription:
182 MEDITATIONES CIRCA
decimo poteſtatibus $p^2$, $p^4$, aequiualeant impares $p^9$
et $p^7$. Deinde etiam coefficientes A, B, C, D etc.
multo ſimpliciori lege exhiberi poſſunt, quae im-
mediate ex coefficientibus binomii ad eandem digni-
tatem, cuius ordinis iſtae aequationes quaeruntur,
eleuati, fluit, hoc modo:
Ordo $m+n=11$
$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c|c|l} p^{11} & p^1 & p^3 & p^5 & p^7 & p^9 & \\ q^{10}=\frac{1}{2}(1+11) & -1 & -1 & -1 & -1 & -1 & +p=p^{10} \\ q^9=\frac{1}{2}(1-55) & * & +2 & +4 & +6 & +8+1 & \\ q^8=\frac{1}{2})1+165) & * & -1 & -6 & -15 & -28-8 & +p^3=p^8 \\ q^7=\frac{1}{2}(1-330) & * & * & +4 & +20+1 & +56+28 & \\ q^6=\frac{1}{2}(1+462) & * & * & -1 & -15-6 & -70-56 & +p^5=p^6 \\ q^5=\frac{1}{2}(1-462) & * & * & +1 & +6+15 & +56+70 & \\ q^4=\frac{1}{2}(1+330) & * & * & -4 & -1-20 & -28-56 & +p^7=p^4 \\ q^3=\frac{1}{2}(1-165) & * & +1 & +6 & +15 & +8+28 & \\ q^2=\frac{1}{2}(1+55) & * & -2 & -4 & -6 & -1-8 & +p^9=p^2 \\ q^1=\frac{1}{2}(1-11) & +1 & +1 & +1 & +1 & +1 & \end{array}$
In qualibet ſcilicet columna verticali coefficientes
binomii ad dignitatem vnitate inferiorem eleuati
tum a ſummo deorſum quum ab imo ſurſum ſcri-
buntur, et vbi bini concurrunt in vnam ſummam
colliguntur.
36. Hinc iam licebit pro omnibus ordinibus
imparibus rem in genere definire; at quoniam hic
coefficientes binomii poteſtatum occurrunt, vt bre-
vitati conſulamus, ſcribamus
$\frac{n(n-1)(n-2)\ldots(n-\nu+1)}{1.\;2.\;3\;\ldots\;\nu}=n(\nu)$;
vt

items.quote: Deinde etiam coefficientes A, B, C, D etc. multo ſimpliciori lege exhiberi poſſunt, quae immediate ex coefficientibus binomii ad eandem dignitatem, cuius ordinis iſtae aequationes quaeruntur, eleuati, fluit
items.english: Then also the coefficients A, B, C, D etc. can be exhibited by a much simpler law, which flows immediately from the coefficients of the binomial raised to the same power as the order whose equations are sought.

items.quote: In qualibet ſcilicet columna verticali coefficientes binomii ad dignitatem vnitate inferiorem eleuati tum a ſummo deorſum quum ab imo ſurſum ſcribuntur, et vbi bini concurrunt in vnam ſummam colliguntur.
items.english: Namely, in each vertical column the coefficients of the binomial raised to the power one lower are written both from the top downward and from the bottom upward, and where two meet they are combined into one sum.

items.quote: Hinc iam licebit pro omnibus ordinibus imparibus rem in genere definire
items.english: From this it will now be possible to determine the matter in general for all odd orders.
